ci: stop patching jsdom WPT expectations in integration tests (#664)

The jsdom integration jobs exist to alert us when a tough-cookie change
affects jsdom, not to gate merges. Patching jsdom's to-run.yaml hides
exactly that signal, so run jsdom's test suite with its expectations
as-is and drive expectation changes upstream
